name: Shivansh Finserve Limited
about: Shivansh Finserve Limited provides financial services to businesses and corporates in India. The company offers finance against mortgage of the property; working capital facility requirement; overdraft facility; ad hoc facility from bankers; cash credit facility; working capital demand loan; bank guaranty; local foreign LC; packing credit in foreign currency; bill discounting; export bill disc; export and foreign bill purchase; cash purchase; factoring facility; and working capital demand loan. It also offers home, reconstruction, advance, and vehicle loans. The company was formerly known as Manasarovar Financial Services Limited and changed its name to Shivansh Finserve Limited in May 2015. Shivansh Finserve Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
